name: 4K Barbers
review_texts:
I had a hair cut with Hamoud. It is my first time. I really loved his hair cut. Friendly environment. I was offered coffee as well.

Today I went to cut hair. Stylist Rayan cut for me. He is fast and efficient. I liked it.

I had a cut with Mo today 7th Nov25. See the pictures for it.

Today 31May2026, Mohamed cut for me. He is very patient and did very good job.

Qasim cut for me today 5th Jul 2026. Very good service.

Abu Adam cut for me today 2nd Sep 2026. Nice hair stylist

Came here multiple times, went in recently wasted my time by making me wait and tell my skin condition I have is ‘destroying’ their trimmers they use. Instead of blaming they can clean and maintain their trimmers. I was led to believe they were disability friendly as on previous occasions they have mentioned no problems prior.

But they care more about their image of how a person looks instead of treating people with respect. Really shameful behaviour and disrespectful by Ariyan. I would avoid a...

I had previously been satisfied with this barbershop, but my most recent visit was extremely disappointing. Despite showing the same reference photo I used during my first two successful appointments, the haircut I received this time was completely off and very poorly executed.

The result was messy, uneven, and far below the standard I expected as a returning customer.

Unfortunately, this experience has changed my opinion of the shop, and I won’t be returning.
Great service, Connor had cut my hair and gave an excellent fade. Decor of the place is amazing, you can chill and have coffee while you wait. Friendly staff, amazing fares and great value!

My son is very happy with his first cut from 4K Barbers. They listened to what he wanted and did a great job. The atmosphere was very friendly and it was nice to be offered tea and coffee while we waited. We will be definitely be returning.

name: Pro Wash and Go Hand Car Wash
review_texts: Great wash and clean  really impressed with the results. The alloys were cleaned perfectly, with all the brake dust removed and a nice shine left behind. The whole car looked spotless, with a smooth, glossy finish and no streaks. Definitely recommend if you want your car looking clean and fresh.

My first exprience with Pro Wash and Go Hand Car Wash and I must admit the service was absolutely spotless. The job was done in excellent condition, quick and very well. Guys have such a great sense of humour and respect. Definitely I ll be looking forward to come back.
Had a really good experience with the staff. The car was genuinely in a very dirty state but they got it all cleaned really nice.

Did mini vallet service on my car to get prped for selling it off and the lads did an amazing job. Took great care to wash the harder to reach places, and everything I pointed out as extremely dirty. On top of that everyone was very friendly. Highly recommend.

Our 4x4 was filthy, we needed to get it clean ready for Carwow as we’d decided to sell it. We found the guys to be thorough and careful when cleaning the car both inside and out, the price was reasonable too. We live in a very rural area where passing farm vehicles chuck up plenty of spray. We have since used them again, price is reasonable and they do a good job.

name: Empire barbers

review_texts: Had my little boy’s hair cut (he’s only two) and they did a great job. My boy was a bit scared but they made him feel at ease and did a really neat job of his hair. Would definitely recommend!
Always friendly. Great hair cuts. But beyond that my lad is shy and doesn’t speak well with people. But the barbers here are kind and encouraging, they really do make him feel welcome.

Fantastic place to get your hair cut, really look after you and do an amazing job, all the staff are really friendly and have a good attitude, one of the best trims I’ve had in a while 10/10 recommendation

Amazing experience staff members treated me with the utmost care and left me with a great customer experience. And the attention to detail in the haircut was excellent! Would highly recommend anyone wanting a 5 star barber experience.
My son gets his haircut from here and they are the best! Won’t choose anywhere else! Highly recommend

name: Star Barbers - Leicester
review_texts: First time visiting Star Barbers and the service was top class! The place was clean and the staff were very friendly, which made the experience even better. Abdullah cut my hair and he was excellent at his job really listened to what I wanted and delivered exactly to my requirements. Since moving to Leicester, I’m glad to say I’ve found my go-to barber. Highly recommend!
Top quality service, Everything from the cut to the beard trim and wax was done perfectly, and the hot towel finish made it even better……Will definitely be back….

An absolutely superb haircut from Ali. I had a skin fade and beard shape‑up, and my son had a taper fade — both were done with real precision. The whole team is friendly, and the atmosphere is genuinely welcoming; you feel at home as soon as you walk in. Off‑street parking right outside makes it even easier. I’ve definitely found my local barber and will be returning without hesitation. If you want a proper skin fade done well, I’d happily recommend the team!

Very friendly and helpful my husband is a wheelchair user they always go out their way to help him, give him Alot of attention..
They don't rush with the hair cut, very friendly excellent costomer service always.

Very immaculate service by Ali , he was very friendly and communicative and very nice as well , he is very good at small talks and haircut was on point as well as the beard trimming , also got an free hot towel on top. The other staff are also very nice they greet you upon arrival , defo recommended 10/10

name: Modern Barbers

I’ll definitely be returning. Great barber, great service and a really welcoming a...

First time here and Hamid was awesome. He gave me a fresh cut and I honestly left feeling like I looked 10 years younger. Great attention to detail and even better conversation. Definitely coming back!

Amazing experience with Aisan! Friendly, professional, and really takes the time to understand exactly what you want. The attention to detail is top notch, and the haircut came out clean and sharp. The shop has a great atmosphere too relaxed and welcoming. Highly recommend Aisan if you’re looking for a reliable barber. Will definitely be coming back!

I came here for my first haircut after moving to Leeds due to the highly rated Google reviews. The quality and speed of service was good, with friendly conversation. I was a little surprised by the price of £25 for a skin fade after getting them for £20 in central London, so will explore cheaper options with the multiple alternatives nearby.

name: Elite cut
review_texts: Was passing through. I never leave reviews but the cut I just had from Adam was like going to a spa on top of a haircut. Great guy and great value 👏

Great experience for my first visit—friendly, professional, and really listened to what I wanted. Will definitely be back!

Also gives me discount on haircut. Great experience

Also amazing reception from the apprentice Sirwan, who offered everyone a drink and was very pleasant to chat to as we waited for the bosses to arrive from an appointment of theirs that overran

I had an incredible experience. The team is super friendly and welcoming, and they make you feel comfortable right away. Rahimi did my haircut and went beyond what I expected. The result was even better than what I had in mind. Great service, great atmosphere, and real attention to detail. I will definitely come back.

But the barber was very patient and took the time to understand what I wanted. Step by step, he worked towards the style I had in mind, and I’m really happy with the result.

The price is also very reasonable — with the student discount, it was only £11, which I think is great value.

name: Kurd Cut Barbers
review_texts: Great place with great barbers - very quick and efficient and great with kids! My 3 year old sat through a full haircut without any complaints. These guys know how to cut hair and style it well! Prices were also very reasonable - defo worth a visit if you need a good haircut!

I visited them this morning and received excellent customer service. I felt relaxed and comfortable with them. Definitely going to be my favorite place.

On top of that, he’s genuinely one of the nicest guys you’ll meet, makes you feel comfortable straight away and takes his time to get everything perfect. You can tell he takes real pride in his work.

If you’re serious about getting a clean, sharp ...

The other day, I wanted to get my haircut fixed because I realized the new hair didn’t quite suit my face cut. So I called up the owner and he fixed it the next day for no extra cost! Kudos!

name: HAIR STUDIO 7x12
review_texts: Absolutely fantastic barber. Professional, welcoming, and consistently delivers a top-quality haircut every time. Attention to detail is excellent, the service is friendly and relaxed, and you never feel rushed. Easily one of the best barbers in the Watford area. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable, skilled barber with great customer service. Five stars.

Friendly staff and a great place for a haircut. They took their time, listened to what I wanted, and the result was exactly what I was looking for. The shop is clean, the atmosphere is welcoming, and the service is excellent. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a reliable barber in Watford!

Thanks,
Kishu
